messages:
Alex: Quick feedback from today's hallway testing — people keep asking what "pin" actually does. They expect it to stick to the current filter set.
Rina: Yep. We need clearer affordances. Two quick ideas: add a tiny help icon next to the pin that on hover says "Pin scope: global by default" and a one-time tooltip onboarding when first use.
Sam: I like the onboarding overlay. Also propose a user preference: Settings > Catalog > Default pin scope [Global | Current view]. Makes power users happy.
Jo: Badge density note: the performance badges are visually dominant. Could we add a per-view toggle (top-right) "Show badges" that hides all decorative badges but keeps primary metrics? Useful for compare-heavy flows.
Priya: Per-view toggle is nice. Remember to persist it in local storage per user so they don't have to toggle each time.
Alex: For the pin UI: sketch a compact split-button on the row action: main action = Pin to current view, caret = open menu with Pin globally + Pin to this view + Help. Default action should match user pref.
Rina: Microcopy: change help text to "Pinned versions stay across filter changes unless pinned to this view. Learn more." Link to short doc. Avoid jargon.
Sam: Edge case: CSV export of compare results should include the pinned version column and flag which column was pinned so consumers know what they exported. Add to export spec.
Jo: Accessibility: if we hide badges with the toggle, ensure the toggle is announced and the table announces new column layout to screen readers (aria-live region).
Priya: Also add a small sr-only note in the header when pin changes: "Pinned model version v2.3.1 (global)" that is inserted into an aria-live polite region.
Alex: Motion: when pinning animate a tiny dot that flies into the header chip — subtle transform/opacity only. Keep duration ~120ms.
Rina: CSS snippet for compact badge + hit target:
```css
.badge-compact{ width:18px; height:18px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.badge-compact .hit{ padding:7px; margin:-7px; }
```
Sam: Engineering note: if we add the "Show badges" toggle, make it controlled by feature flag so we can A/B test engagement with compact mode.
Jo: QA items: pinned scope toggle, export includes pinned flag, aria-live announcements on pin change, and keyboard flow for split-pin-button. I'll add tests.
Priya: UX nit: when filters update and pinned version is no longer visible in the result set, show a small warning in the header: "Pinned version not in current results" with a CTA to "Show pinned". Helps avoid confusion.
Alex: Love that. Also add an analytics event whenever users change pin scope or toggle badges so we can quantify confusion and adoption.
DesignBot: Reminder: add a11y checklist and localization keys for new copy.
QA-Bot: Reminder: include automated test for pin persistence across filter groups and for CSV export columns.
Alex: Next steps: Rina to mock split-pin-button + help overlay, Sam to spec export change + feature flag, Jo to own QA test cases, Priya to update copy and aria strings. Review Fri 3pm.
Rina: Will upload Figma frames with a short recording of the pin onboarding overlay.
Sam: I'll draft the export schema and add telemetry events.
Jo: Adding QA ticket now.
Priya: I'll create i18n keys and ping localization owners.
Alex: Thanks team :sparkles:
